title: Small ripple, *big* whip
subtitle: A 5% swing in sales, a 50% swing upstream. Illustrative numbers.

stages.name: Shop shelf
stages.desc: Real sales move about 5% week to week

stages.name: Distributor
stages.desc: Orders in batches, loads up at month-end

stages.name: Bottling plant
stages.desc: Plans from orders, not sales, adds a buffer

stages.name: Preform supplier
stages.desc: Hears the loudest, least true signal

takeaway: Bullwhip ratio = swing in orders ÷ swing in real sales. Above 1 adds noise.

author.name: Hammad Ulhaq
author.role: Head of Supply Chain · 20+ yrs FMCG & Beverages
